post.title: Democrats Won Congress. Half of You Are Furious. #shorts
post.description: From Jan 3, Democrats control the House and Senate. They run the committees, and judges and cabinet picks need their votes, but the veto stays. Same results, two realities: that's motivated reasoning. Comment 1 for checks & balances, 2 for gridlock, and blue or red for who you support.
